executiveSummary: Iran-affiliated actors are exploiting internet-exposed PLCs (Rockwell, Schneider, Siemens), manipulating logic and HMI/SCADA, with confirmed operational disruptions across multiple U.S. critical infrastructure sectors. Immediate removal of PLCs from public internet and secured remote access is required. Security Advisory CISA separately urged the Water and Wastewater Systems sector to harden OT after password/IP tampering on exposed PLCs forced boil-water notices and prolonged manual operations. Security Advisory Large-scale FortiGate credential exposure ("FortiBleed") places VPN perimeters and AD-integrated access at immediate risk; organizations should rotate credentials, enforce MFA, and upgrade to PBKDF2-based FortiOS. Security Advisory Mass exploitation of VMware vCenter CVE-2026-59310 (syslog traversal → RCE) began within days of disclosure; evidence of reverse SSH persistence demands urgent patching and compromise assessment, especially where virtualized OT workloads reside. View Article Critical web-app exposures are being actively targeted: Rails Active Storage RCE (public exploit), Metabase unauth SQLi, and KEV-listed Cisco ASA/FTD and Windows AFD flaws elevate risks to identity, segmentation, and data sources used by OT. Security Advisory Security Advisory Zimbra zero-day phishing/exfiltration by Russian state-supported actors (LAUNDRY BEAR) enabled large-scale mailbox theft and credential access across government, DIB, and energy-mandating immediate patching and revocation of app passwords/2FA scratch codes. Security Advisory Johnson Controls Airwall contains a universal cryptographic key (pre-4.1.0), undermining OT micro-segmentation and secure remote access unless patched and keys rotated. ICS Advisory China-nexus covert device networks and AI-assisted intrusions (e.g., Taiwan gov/energy) highlight increasing automation in reconnaissance and access operations with potential CI/OT implications. Security Advisory View Article Weekly CISA bulletins enumerate multiple high-impact OT/IIoT issues (OPC UA, ActiveMQ, EVSEs, telecom control suites), reinforcing the need for rapid patch triage and strong network segmentation. topThreats.title: 1) PLC Intrusions with Operational Impact
topThreats.action: Iran-affiliated actors are modifying PLC logic and HMI states on internet-exposed devices; immediate removal from public internet and segmented, MFA-protected remote access are mandatory.

topThreats.title: 2) FortiGate "FortiBleed" Credentials Exposure
topThreats.action: Leaked FortiGate credentials enable VPN and AD compromise. Rotate all secrets, enforce MFA, upgrade to PBKDF2-based hashing, and assess for prior misuse.

topThreats.title: 3) vCenter CVE-2026-59310 Mass Exploitation
topThreats.action: Rapidly exploited unauth RCE with reverse-SSH persistence threatens virtualized OT workloads; patch and conduct IR to evict intruders.

topThreats.title: 4) Zimbra LAUNDRY BEAR Mailbox Exfiltration
topThreats.action: View-only email exploit enables exfiltration of messages and credentials; patch immediately, revoke app passwords/2FA codes, and hunt for IOCs.

topThreats.title: 5) Johnson Controls Airwall Universal Key
topThreats.action: Hardcoded universal key (pre-4.1.0) undermines OT segmentation/remote access; patch to ≥4.1.0 and rotate all keys/certs immediately.

items: Iran-affiliated actors: multi-sector PLC manipulation and modem persistence; living-off-the-land with vendor tools. Security Advisory
Pro-Russia hacktivists: opportunistic VNC/HMI intrusions against WWS/F&A/Energy with default/weak creds. Security Advisory
LAUNDRY BEAR (Russia): Zimbra zero-day mailbox/data exfiltration across government/DIB/energy. Security Advisory
Lazarus (DPRK): active Windows AFD zero-day exploitation with rootkit and backdoors via job-lure campaigns. View Article
Head Mare APT: TrueConf server RCE → backdoored installers; targets include transportation/energy/manufacturing. Supporting Report
Gunra RaaS: Fortinet perimeter exploitation, cloud exfiltration, and Windows/Linux encryption; Linux PRNG weakness may allow recovery. Security Advisory

relevance: - Direct OT impact is evidenced by PLC intrusions causing loss-of-view and process changes; building automation controllers and OT security gateways exhibit high-severity flaws that can enable remote manipulation and lateral movement. - Enterprise perimeters (firewalls, VPNs, load balancers, CI/CD, collaboration) continue to be prime entry points for IT-to-OT pivots; several are now in KEV with active exploitation warnings. - Messaging/protocol components (OPC UA, ActiveMQ) and EV charging infrastructure add risk to industrial data flows and energy load management, reinforcing the need for strict zoning and protocol allow-listing.

outlook72h: - Prioritize emergency changes: remove any internet-exposed PLCs/HMIs; enforce MFA/allow-lists on OT gateways; patch vCenter, Metabase, and KEV-listed perimeters; rotate Fortinet and identity credentials. - Conduct targeted threat hunts for: reverse SSH tunnels from management networks; suspicious Zimbra SOAP/API sequences; unexplained PLC logic changes; anomalous ActiveMQ/OPC UA traffic; Metabase reset_password endpoint hits. - Freeze risky changes on segmentation/remote-access platforms until keys and configurations are rotated and validated (e.g., JCI Airwall).
